body.title: Analyzer lookups state an incomplete repository
body.summary: ExplorationRunnerContext (src/analyze/explore/types.ts) gains repoCompleteness, set at all three context constructions in executor.ts (around :216, :522, :584); graphCompleteness adds only repoCompleteness? to its parameter; usage.example, import.graph, class.hierarchy, data-model.trace and convention.detect pass it, so an incomplete repository yields notEstablished with the reasons in the basis note. Anchors: graphCompleteness (src/analyze/explore/completeness-facts.ts:66-74) has 19 call sites in 14 files; only the five relationship lookups pass repoCompleteness (src/analyze/explore/usage-example.ts:141/:183, src/analyze/explore/import-graph.ts:106/:181, src/analyze/explore/class-hierarchy.ts:113/:187, src/analyze/explore/data-model-trace.ts:105/:206, src/analyze/explore/convention-detect.ts:114/:169). The other nine callers (concept-resolve, manifests-locate, symbol-locate, test-locate, discovery-entrypoints, discovery-modules, structure-module-tree, surface-functional, adherence) do not walk relationships and keep their calls unchanged; the field is optional. ExplorationRunnerContext (src/analyze/explore/types.ts:880-905) is built at three PRODUCTION places in src/analyze/explore/executor.ts (the object literals at :214-218, :520-524 and :582-586; the only three uses of ignoreFilter in a context). Depends on t2 for completenessOf. repoCompleteness is optional on ExplorationRunnerContext: about ten test fixtures in src/analyze/explore/__tests__/ (e.g. completeness-all-lookups.test.ts:109, failed-lookups.test.ts:209) build a context without it and keep compiling; absent means no repository facts, so the lookup's completeness is computed as today.
acceptanceChecks: Each of the five lookups reports notEstablished with the counts for an incomplete repository and as today for a complete one
graphCompleteness's 19 existing call sites compile and behave unchanged; the nine non-relationship callers do not pass repoCompleteness

tests.name: src/analyze/explore/__tests__/completeness-all-lookups.test.ts: five lookups notEstablished for an incomplete repository, executor sets the field at all three constructions (mutation: one construction left without it)
